title: AI Builders Digest
subtitle: Bilingual edition · 双语对照版

intro.text: 今天的 feed 里，AI 产品的竞争越来越像是在争夺一个人的完整工作环境：账号、桌面、手机、浏览器、context，以及 agent 能持续工作的权限。Claude 在扩大高强度使用额度，Codex 在推进多账号切换，Google 则把 Gemini 直接带到新设备首发；另一边，builder 们开始认真讨论 sandbox、自维护软件和自己的 harness。

archive.title: 工作环境重构日报
archive.desc: AI 产品正在从单点助手扩张成覆盖设备、账号、应用和维护流程的完整工作环境。

footerNote: Source: Follow Builders curated daily digest. Rebuilt from the 2026-11-01 source feeds.

sections.title: The Agentic Workspace / Agent 工作台
sections.desc: 今天最明显的产品信号，是 agent 正从一个聊天入口变成覆盖桌面、账号和应用生命周期的工作层。

rewrite: OpenAI's Codex and ChatGPT team is pushing toward a multi-account workflow: users can now switch accounts easily on mobile, with desktop support coming soon. The teasing detail is that the next two days will involve resets and banked capacity, a reminder that account boundaries and usage limits are becoming part of the product experience itself.
original:
Day 26/ You can now easily switch between multiple accounts on mobile, and coming soon to desktop too. Next two days will be resets… banked… do with this what you may 👀.

https://t.co/iQxsqbuk0f

rewrite: OpenAI 的 Codex 和 ChatGPT 团队正在把多账号工作流做成产品能力：现在可以在手机上方便地切换多个账号，桌面端也即将支持。更值得注意的是，他还预告了接下来两天的 reset 和 banked capacity，说明账号边界和使用额度本身，正在成为产品体验的一部分。
original:
第 26 天：现在可以在手机上轻松切换多个账号，桌面端也即将支持。接下来两天会有 reset……banked……你们自行理解 👀。

https://t.co/iQxsqbuk0f

rewrite: Google Labs VP Josh Woodward points to a simple distribution advantage: Gemini was available and optimized for the iPhone Duo on day one. The broader lesson is that an AI assistant's value is partly determined by how quickly it becomes native to the devices people actually use.
original: Last Friday, the iPhone Duo came out. @GeminiApp was there on day 1, optimized for it. https://t.co/izOwYBdMf9

rewrite: Google Labs VP Josh Woodward 强调了一个很直接的分发优势：iPhone Duo 上周五发布时，Gemini App 第一天就已经适配。更大的启示是，AI 助手的价值不只取决于模型能力，也取决于它能多快成为用户正在使用的设备的原生体验。
original: 上周五 iPhone Duo 发布了。@GeminiApp 第一天就已上线，并针对它完成优化。https://t.co/izOwYBdMf9

sections.title: Usage Becomes the Battleground / 使用额度成为战场
sections.desc: 模型能力相近时，真正影响重度用户选择的，可能是能用多久、如何验证，以及限制如何变化。

rewrite: Claude is renaming its Max tiers and removing the five-hour limit for verified Ultra accounts. Max 5x becomes Max, Max 20x becomes Ultra, and the prices stay at $100 and $200 per month; weekly limits remain unchanged. This is less about making usage infinite than about making high-intensity bursts more practical for verified users.
original:
We’re renaming our Max plans: 

Max 5x → Max
Max 20x → Ultra

Max is still $100/month, and Ultra is still $200. If you’re a subscriber, there’s nothing you need to do.

We’re also removing the 5-hour limit for verified Ultra accounts, starting today with most existing subscribers. Newer accounts keep a temporary limit until they’re verified, which helps us prevent fraud and abuse. You'll get an email when it's removed.

Weekly limits remain unchanged. View our plans here:  https://t.co/niRpyGF5Me

rewrite: Claude 正在重新命名 Max 套餐，并取消已验证 Ultra 账号的 5 小时限制。Max 5x 改为 Max，Max 20x 改为 Ultra，月费仍是 100 美元和 200 美元，每周限额不变。它不是把使用变成无限量，而是让已验证用户更适合进行高强度、连续的工作。
original:
我们要重新命名 Max 套餐：

Max 5x → Max
Max 20x → Ultra

Max 仍然是每月 100 美元，Ultra 仍然是每月 200 美元。订阅用户无需做任何操作。

我们也将从今天开始取消已验证 Ultra 账户的 5 小时限制，大多数现有订阅用户都会立即生效。新账户在完成验证前会暂时保留限制，以帮助防止欺诈和滥用。取消限制时你会收到邮件。

每周限额不变。套餐详情：https://t.co/niRpyGF5Me

rewrite: Claude engineer Boris Cherny reduces the same announcement to its user-facing consequence: verified Ultra accounts no longer have the five-hour limit. The short follow-up matters because it shows how the headline plan change translates into the day-to-day workflow of heavy users.
original: We're removing the 5-hour limit for verified Ultra accounts. https://t.co/CewlkJkBmj

rewrite: Claude 工程师 Boris Cherny 把同一项调整压缩成了用户真正关心的结果：已验证 Ultra 账号不再受 5 小时限制。这个简短的跟进很重要，因为它把套餐公告翻译成了重度用户每天实际会感受到的工作流变化。
original: 我们将取消已验证 Ultra 账号的 5 小时限制。https://t.co/CewlkJkBmj

sections.title: Software That Keeps Working / 软件开始自我维护
sections.desc: 如果 agent 不只负责生成，还负责修复和持续运行，那么软件交付的终点就不再是部署那一刻。

rewrite: Replit CEO Amjad Masad calls a hosted app with autofix enabled “Self-Maintaining Software.” The interesting change is not another code-generation demo: the application is being positioned as something that can keep itself healthy after launch. That moves agentic software from a one-off build step toward an ongoing operational loop.
original: If you host your apps on Replit and enable “autofix” it becomes Self-Maintaining Software. https://t.co/ezhwiI7ccw https://t.co/6uTsADTHro

rewrite: Replit CEO Amjad Masad 把开启 autofix 的托管应用称为“Self-Maintaining Software”。有意思的地方不只是又一个代码生成 demo，而是应用开始被定义为一种上线后还能持续保持健康的东西。agentic software 因此从一次性构建步骤，向持续运行的运维闭环移动。
original: 如果你把应用托管在 Replit 上并开启“autofix”，它就会变成 Self-Maintaining Software。https://t.co/ezhwiI7ccw https://t.co/6uTsADTHro

rewrite: Masad also points to Replit's work on sandboxing agents to maximize productivity while reducing risk. Put together with self-maintaining software, the design problem becomes clear: agents need enough access to act usefully, but their environment must make that access bounded and recoverable.
original:
We wrote a whitepaper on how to properly sandbox agents to maximize productivity and reduce risk.

https://t.co/5ihrJ6zkGj

rewrite: Masad 同时提到 Replit 正在研究如何对 agent 做 sandbox，在提高生产力的同时降低风险。把这件事和自维护软件放在一起看，设计问题就很清楚了：agent 必须拥有足够权限才能真正做事，但它所在的环境必须让这些权限可控、可恢复。
original:
我们写了一份白皮书，介绍如何正确地对 agent 做 sandbox，在最大化生产力的同时降低风险。

https://t.co/5ihrJ6zkGj

sections.title: Builders Keep Their Own Layer / Builder 保留自己的那一层
sections.desc: 工具越强，越需要有人把 context、权限和工作习惯从单一平台里抽出来，形成自己的可迁移层。

rewrite: Peter Steinberger argues for using your own harness rather than one whose capabilities a company can change at will. The point is operational control: once a harness carries your permissions and workflow, its behavior is infrastructure, not a disposable interface.
original: Another reason why you wanna use your own harness and not one where companies change what you can or can’t do at will. https://t.co/eX9uv6spfR

rewrite: Peter Steinberger 主张使用自己的 harness，而不是依赖一个公司可以随时改变能力边界的 harness。核心是运行控制权：一旦 harness 承载了你的权限和工作流，它就已经是基础设施，不再只是一个可以随时替换的界面。
original: 另一个应该使用自己 harness 的理由：不要依赖一个公司可以随意改变你能做什么、不能做什么的 harness。https://t.co/eX9uv6spfR

rewrite: Builder Zara Zhang says a coding agent completed her video editing with a single, very long prompt. The post is intentionally sparse, but that is exactly why it is useful as a signal: for some creative work, the agent is moving from assistant to end-to-end operator, with the user's main contribution becoming direction rather than manual execution.
original: Video editing was done with just 1 prompt (a very long one) by a coding agent

rewrite: Builder Zara Zhang 说，她的视频剪辑只用了一个很长的 prompt，就由 coding agent 完成了。原帖很简短，但信号很清楚：对一部分创作工作来说，agent 正从辅助工具走向端到端执行者，用户的主要贡献开始从手动操作变成方向判断。
original: 视频剪辑只用了 1 个 prompt（一个很长的 prompt），由 coding agent 完成。
